$comment: GULLHOLLOW, the coast road's rare-encounter spot: the pocket in the cliff under the salt pans where the birds nest. Gullswift is the point of the place and takes a third of the table, against eight percent on the open road. BRINEWISP at six is the prize -- tide/spirit, catch rate 60, no evolution, and the only one in the region until the wetlands in Act 3 -- and it is evening and night only, so a player who wants it has to come back at the right time rather than stand here. Levels sit at 14-16, one to two under a solo lead and level with a team-raiser leaving Route 4, and the two heavy payers (Gullswift 128, Brinewisp 168) are pinned at the bottom of their bands for the same reason they are on the ridge.
